encounter_greeting.text: Halt, ser {player}! I am {persona} of the Tesnovar Wardenry, and no banner of {my_faction} shall be trampled while I still draw breath.
Good day, ser {player}. I am {persona}, sworn to {my_faction} and riding under its colours. State your business plainly, traveller.
Well met, ser {player}! {persona} greets you in the name of {my_faction}. May our paths cross in honour and never in quarrel.
Ser {player}, you stand upon ground my ancestors bled for. {persona} of {my_faction} will not yield a single stone of it.

encounter_threatened.text: Surrender, ser {player}? Tesnovar does not kneel to common brigands. Keep your {gold} gold and come and take my sword if you dare.
You demand {gold} gold of me, ser {player}? A bold tongue for a man with such a thin purse. Speak again and let the ancestors judge your answer.
Pay you {gold} gold? I would sooner feed my shield to the mud. Draw your steel, ser {player}, and let us see what your coin is worth.
Ser {player}, I hope you jest, for we have shared too much road to be enemies. Yet I cannot pay {gold} gold, and I refuse with a heavy heart.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: An alliance, ser {player}? I accept, provided your word is sound. Together we shall break {enemy_faction}, and I shall be watching how you bear yourself.
Ser {player}, I accept your offer gladly! Let our banners stand side by side against {enemy_faction}, and let the ancestors witness it.
Your hand is clasped in mine, ser {player}! Tesnovar will remember this day as surely as the ancestors remember their oaths.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No alliance with you, ser {player}. Your word is not yet worth the ink that would bind it, and I will not stain Tesnovar's banner with it.
I must decline, ser {player}. My oath keeps me to my own road for now. Perhaps another season will see us differently.
Ally with you, ser {player}? I would sooner ride beside {rival}, and that is saying a great deal of contempt. Begone from my sight.
Ser {player}, it grieves me to refuse a friend. Yet my banners have no room for an alliance this season. Accept my regret and my respect.

captured_by_player.text: So, ser {player}, you have taken me as your prisoner. Ransom me for {gold} gold if you must, but know that {my_faction} will not forget this shame.
I am your captive, ser {player}, and I bow to the fortune of war. Name your ransom of {gold} gold and I shall see it paid.
A fine stroke, ser {player}, though I wish it had fallen on another day. I am your prisoner, and I ask only that you treat me as a knight of {my_faction}.
Chained like a common thief, I am, ser {player}. Hear this: my ancestors will remember your face, and {my_faction} will settle its debt with you.

released_by_player.text: Ser {player} spared me when mercy was not owed. Tesnovar remembers, and the debt shall be repaid in a fair duel.
Ser {player}, your mercy was unlooked for. I am grateful and will speak well of you, though my oath stands as before.
Ser {player} let me go without ransom. Honour has been shown on both sides, and I shall not forget it.
Ser {player}, you freed me without ransom and I count it a debt of honour. Should you need my sword, you have only to ask.
Ser {player} released me with no ransom at all! Such generosity will be sung in every hall of the Wardenry.

player_left_my_faction.text: Ser {player} has abandoned {my_faction} for {faction}. Let it be written that oaths sworn in Tesnovar's hall are not so lightly broken.
Ser {player}, you turned your banner to {faction} and left {my_faction} in the mud. I will remember the shame you carried away with you.
Ser {player} has ridden from {my_faction} to join {faction}. The ancestors will judge that choice, not I.
Ser {player}, I hear you have sworn yourself to {faction}. Choose your road with care, for every oath is a stone upon your back.

war_declared.text: {my_faction} declares war on {enemy_faction}. Let the saga be written in blood and honour, and let our names be sung in every hall.
War is declared between {my_faction} and {enemy_faction}. Tesnovar stands ready, and our oath to the ancestors grows heavier this day.
{enemy_faction} has dared to make war on {my_faction}. We shall answer with steel, as our forebears would have done.
{my_faction} and {enemy_faction} are at war once more. I pray the ancestors grant us a victory worthy of the telling.

fought_alongside_player.text: Ser {player}, our {troop_count} blades stood firm, and {enemy_faction} lies broken before us. I will grant that you fought with honour today.
Ser {player}, what a day! Our {troop_count} blades and your courage have crushed {enemy_faction}. Let the minstrels sing of it for a generation.

encounter_farewell.text: Begone from my sight, ser {player}. Our quarrel is unfinished, and I shall collect on it when the wind turns.
Farewell, ser {player}. May your road be long and your purse heavy.
Farewell, dear ser {player}! May the ancestors guard your road and bring us together under better banners.
The parley is done, ser {player}. Ride well, and remember that honour travels faster than rumour.

ambient_chatter.text: The rain over {town} is a sign from the ancestors, I am certain of it. Our march shall wait until the skies grow kind.
Has anyone seen the road to {village}? I was promised bread there, and a sworn knight cannot march on an empty stomach.
Hear me, travellers of the road! The hills above {village} are green, and I have never seen a finer morning for honour.
A bard in {village} sang of the old wars last night, and I wept openly, as a true knight of the Wardenry should.
